title: hold supplier verifier input
description: Run a background check on one domain, or compare an unfamiliar sender domain against a supplier's known domain.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'background' checks one domain on its own. 'copycat' compares domain against knownDomain.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Domain to check (background mode), or the unfamiliar sender domain (copycat mode). No scheme, e.g. "example.com".

businessName.title: Business name
businessName.description: The supplier's name on file, compared against the site's title (background mode only).

knownDomain.title: Known domain
knownDomain.description: The supplier's domain on file, to compare domain against (copycat mode only).
